dedupe_keys.name: threat groups targeting operational technology ot compiled attack and actor data tu wien 2023

description: This TU Wien dataset compiles public information on threat groups that attack operational technology (OT) and industrial control systems. Sources include the Threat Group Cards of ThaiCERT, Malpedia of Fraunhofer FKIE, MITRE ATT&CK and the Industrial Control Systems Cyber Emergency Response Team (ICS-CERT), with news articles and threat reports. For each group it records the victim sectors targeted, the actor responsible, the number of publicly reported attacks up to June 2023, the year the group was discovered, and infrastructure details, with the analysis and results. Coverage: global, threat groups known to target OT up to June 2023. Format and access: files in the TU Wien research data repository with a DOI, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: built from public reporting, so attacks that were never disclosed are missing and attribution may be uncertain; a one-off compilation; counts of attacks are not a measure of risk. Simulation uses: frequency and sector targeting of cyber threats as inputs to threat scenarios for cascading failure studies across telecom, energy and water control systems. Related records: data-caida-ucsd-network-telescope observes scanning and attack traffic on the internet; data-5g-nidd-intrusion-detection gives network intrusion traffic for detection models.
